A woman walks naked on the beach, discarding towels offered by Harries before strolling onto the Bondi streets. Another woman is removed by police for drunkenly harassing beachgoers. And lifeguards build the wildest boats imaginable for the end of season 'Surf-en-tag' wave riding competition."
Jesse saves an American tourist from calm waters, combined with a collective CPR effort from the lifeguards, the paramedics, and the Jewish Medical Response team.

Bondi's chiselled lifeguards get a run for their money when all-male-revue Manpower Australia make a surprise visit. A colourful Bondi local is found facedown and unresponsive in the sand. Singlets races to a rescue in the buggy but faces obstacles with flocks of seagulls.

Bondi's new trainee is a member of Maroubra's Bra Boys, trying to turn over a new leaf whilst on a suspended jail sentence. The surf club rescue boat has a spectacular 'upside-down' collision with a reef. Even morphine can't stop a young boy's painful howls when he suffers a mystery stomach illness.

In the most powerful episode ever, two people from the same family drown. The remaining family members watch as lifeguards attempt to resuscitate them, marking a crisis not faced by lifeguards since 1939.

Bondi faces a bluebottle invasion. Lifeguards treat a boy from the UK stung by the painful creatures. Singlets attends a suspected spinal injury, shocked to find that the patient is his son, Star recruit Clint Kimmins uses his big wave surfing skills for a daring rescue of a drowning man.

Chappo and H-man cautiously prepare a 19 year old German tourist for hospital after he's broken his back. Trainees Taco and Jesse have a difficult day in class struggling with the books, but get a chance to make the grade against the rest of the team in the annual lifeguard challenge.

In soaring temperatures, a 2-year-old girl is trapped in a locked car. A mother and daughter are saved by a man who can barely swim himself. Lifeguards catch a bag thief, who sends them on a chase. Harrison must improvise for equipment when he spots swimmers going under after pack-up time.

On the hottest day ever in Bondi, tempers flare in the heat and a fight erupts on the beach. A blistering Northwest wind sweeps a couple and their boogie board half a kilometre out to sea. Terry encounters a man in excruciating pain after losing his boardies.

Chappo must decide which of three struggling swimmers to rescue first. Lifeguards use spotlights when Bondi hosts 15,010 World Pride Beach Party revellers. Hoppo celebrates his 30th year on the beach.
In a frenzied mass rescue, lifeguards search for a student who didn't make it back to the beach. Bagus and Hoppo witness an assault on a woman. Harrison makes a young fan cry - for the right reasons.

During storm season, a tornado hits Southern Sydney. Tourists brave the waves at Bondi. Jesse, alone in the tower, can't assist a drowning man as all lifeguards are busy in the water. Two thrill-seekers encounter trouble in the big swell, and a British rapper embraces the storm to feel the music.

Hundreds of Dutch tourists hit Bondi for a New Years swim - straight in to Backpackers Rip. A diabetic comes to the tower with low blood sugar, and then suffers an epileptic fit. Troy uses the Lifeguard security camera to identify a group of bag thieves operating on Bondi.

A simple miscommunication during a serious rescue could cost two people their lives. Mouse and Chappo help a family to find their lost Grandma. Jess administers adrenaline to a young woman who is suffering an allergic reaction.

programmes.t: I Turned Myself into the Little Mermaid!
programmes.d: Guest host Christina Wilson takes a whimsical dive into mermaid life, transforming underwater for a hilarious and oddly educational aquatic adventure.The batfish looks like something from another planet. Mark dives to find this awkward but fascinating creature of the ocean floor.

The spiny lobster's claws may look small, but one swipe slices skin. Coyote takes a cut and explains this crustacean's anatomy.Tarpon are giant, fast, and aggressive. Coyote gets up close—and briefly inside—during this wild feeding encounter in the water.

The fireworm burns without flame. Mark handles this stinging marine creature and ends up with a fiery rash to prove it.Ever wondered what a thousand mosquito bites look like? Coyote offers his arms as bait and explores how mosquitoes affect humans and ecosystems.

This emotional episode follows chimpanzees rescued from testing labs as they adapt to new lives of freedom and care.Coyote tests an underwater jetpack, soaring through the ocean and meeting sea life in this high-speed dive adventure you have to see to believe!

programmes.t: I Found the World's Smartest Octopus! (Wonderpus)
programmes.d: Mark meets the Wonderpus octopus, a master of camouflage and cognition. This episode is part science lesson, part magical underwater journey.Buried in the sand lies a nightmare: the bobbit worm. Mark reveals this hidden predator's lightning-fast strike and bizarre anatomy.

Massive and prehistoric-looking, this lizard is nicknamed ‘Godzilla' for a reason. Mark tracks it down in its wild habitat.Mark takes a direct sting from the infamous Asian giant hornet. With swelling, pain, and drama, it's one of his most talked-about encounters ever.

This episode features a painful sting from the electric caterpillar, a bizarre jungle dweller with venomous barbs. It's shocking—literally.A sting from Japan's meanest wasp! This aggressive insect doesn't hold back. Mark's reaction is both painful and fascinating.

programmes.t: Salamander Scavenger Hunt! – How Many Will We Find?!
programmes.d: Coyote leads a scavenger hunt to find as many salamanders as possible. With every flip of a log, a new amphibian awaits.Can a frog be poisonous *and* delicious? Coyote tries a legal and safe sample of a species known for its toxins and explains how toxicity works in the wild.

Coyote catches a brilliantly blue frog with a rare genetic mutation. He explains the science behind pigmentation and its survival impact.Coyote tests a supposed parasite cure on himself. Will this so-called kryptonite protect him from infestation? The results may surprise you.

A second sighting of the rare blue frog leaves Coyote stunned. The frog's vibrant coloration is even more incredible up close.Giant bloodworms have jaws and venom, and they're not shy about using either. Mark finds out the hard way.

programmes.t: Bitten by 3 Toxic Worms! (Which Is Worst?)
programmes.d: Three worms, three different toxins. Coyote compares the effects of each to determine which toxic worm inflicts the worst bite of all.Cold-stunned sea turtles wash ashore, helpless. Mark joins a rescue effort to revive and release these beautiful reptiles back to the ocean.

programmes.t: Squirting Clams Pulled Up from the Muck!
programmes.d: Clams that squirt? Mark explores tidal flats where strange mollusks shoot water as a defense mechanism. It's weirder than you think.Bloodworms have teeth and aren't afraid to use them. Mark gets bitten and reveals why these creepy crawlers are misunderstood.

programmes.t: Making a Crabby Tide Pool Aquarium in New England!
programmes.d: Mark builds a tide pool aquarium along the New England coast and fills it with crabs and marine critters. It's hands-on science at its best.The vampire fish lives up to its name. Coyote gets bitten and shows the terrifying teeth and feeding behavior of this river predator.

The sea lamprey is a nightmare with a mouth full of teeth. Coyote experiences what it's like to be eaten alive—literally.Coyote explores a recently abandoned grizzly bear cave, uncovering signs of the massive predator's presence in a thrilling and suspenseful wilderness episode.

Jessy was upset that her friends forgot such a meaningful day to her. // Ling Ling has caught a bad cold and was sneezing all over the place. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase and transforms into a doctor and cares for him.

programmes.st: Behind the Scenes // Paperdoll in Peril
programmes.d: Ling Ling is worried about the play planned for tonight. There are no costumes ready for the villagers so it's hard to figure out which roles they're playing. Rainbow Ruby transforms into a costume designer and designs costumes for her friends. // It is very windy in Rainbow village and Paige, a paper doll, is flying to wherever the wind takes her. Paige very much wants to go to the party but she cannot go without a dress.

With all her memories restored, Yeonwoo meets Seol and asks about what truly happened the day she underwent the shamanic initiation rite. Meanwhile, Hwon orders Hong Gyu-tae to investigate in detail what occurred on the night the Crown Princess collapsed from her sudden illness.

Upon seeing Wol, Bogyeong panics, convinced that the supposedly dead Yeonwoo has returned. Although Yeonwoo comes face to face with Hwon, she chooses not to reveal her true identity. At the same time, Nokyoung discloses to Yeonwoo the name of an unexpected figure implicated in the incident from eight years ago.

With the mystery finally unraveled, Hwon rushes to the Bureau of Beneficence to find Yeonwoo—only for assassins to suddenly appear. In the chaos, Yangmyung grabs Yeonwoo's hand and flees with her. Meanwhile, having lost Yeonwoo once again, Yoon Daehyeong secretly orders assassins to eliminate Nokyoung.

Hwon learns from Hong Gyu-tae that Princess Minhwa was involved in the death of the Crown Princess. Meanwhile, Yeonwoo, who remains by Hwon's side, is tormented by her inability to offer him any comfort. Having reached a final decision, Hwon goes to confront the Grand Queen Dowager.

On her way to warn Hwon of an impending rebellion, Bogyeong witnesses him sharing a tender moment with Yeonwoo. Driven by jealousy and fear, Bogyeong summons Kwon, the former head shaman of Seongsucheong, and orders her to place a dark curse upon Yeonwoo.

A winter-time holiday has arisen in the Eastern Caverns around the mysterious "Giver," who makes an annual visit to deliver slugs to the people of the East. But when a group of thieves make off with the Giver's precious cargo of slugs, our heroes must ride to the rescue-and discover the secret of who the Giver really is.

programmes.st: The Fall of the Eastern Champion
programmes.d: Junjie recounts the ancient history of the Eastern Caverns and his ancestors, and the events that led to his downfall and transformation from the Eastern Champion to the Dark Slinger.
When Pronto accidentally uses the Emperor's sword blaster, he can suddenly do no wrong. Lady Dai-Fu manipulates Underlord Holt into trapping the Shane Gang with a new superweapon: the Iron Warrior!

The Emperor has returned! After the Shane Gang failed to defeat the Iron Warrior, the Emperor sets to work creating even more Unstoppable Warriors to reclaim the Eastern Caverns. The Shane Gang search for a way to defeat the new creations, but when the Emperor places a bounty on Junjie's head, they also have to deal with the Dai-Fu and hordes of the Emperor's Underlords.

programmes.st: The Return of the Eastern Champion
programmes.d: Junjie, Eli and the Gang rally their friends and even some old enemies-to help them take down the Emperor.

The Shane Gang return home to the 99 caverns to find Gateway Cavern overrun with slugs-in Eli's absence, the Shadow Clan have governed by putting the slugs before the people, and the result is chaos! It's up to Eli to restore the balance, but the Shadow Clan aren't as friendly as they once were...and that's saying something. Help comes from an unexpected source-Tad and his slug Pieper, who just arrived from the Surface!

The Shane Gang take Tad under their wing, training him to blast like a pro with Eli's old blaster and teaching him to live by the slugslinger's code. Tad takes to it like a natural, and as Kord says, it looks like they have another "slugslinging savant from the Surface" on their hands. But their training will be put to the test when Tad accompanies them to a showdown with the Scrap Force...and the Shadow Clan!

Tad is still missing after the slug-out with the Shadow Clan, but the Gang have to set off without him when reports start coming in of slugs disappearing all across the 99 caverns. As they pursue the trail of missing slugs, the mystery grows darker when it leads them straight to Dr. Blakk's old stronghold!

Tad's hypnotic slug Pieper has gone megamorph, his gang of supporters all have Gattler blasters, and Tad's control over his army of ghouls is stronger than Dr. Blakk's ever was. The Shane Gang are under non-stop ghoul fire as they struggle to put a stop to Tad's plans and end the mass ghouling of slugs once and for all.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 1
programmes.d: 15-year-old Eli Shane is a regular kid except for one thing: he comes from a long line of Shanes, each who has journied from the surface to protect Slugterra and the slugs that make the world special.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 2
programmes.d: Now its Eli's turn to be Slugterra's next Shane, whether he's ready or not! Unfortunately, the slugslinging tournament he enters to prove that he's ready, pretty quickly shows that he's not!

After the Shane hideout is ransacked, the gang trades in one of Eli's prized slugs for new gear. When Eli has second thoughts they go back to get it, only to learn that it's been sold to Dr. Blakk, along with hundreds of others to be transformed into feral Ghoul Slugs. Eli refuses to let his slug or any other get ghouled, so the team breaks in to Blakk's fortress to free them. While inside, they learn of Blakk's plan to conquer Slugterra.

Tails gets a megadose of Robotniks growth gas and grows quickly to monstrous proportions, eating everything in sight and accidentally terrorizing the countryside.

When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home, Robotnik finds out, and creates a robot fox family which poses as Tails' long lost parents. Sonic leaves Tails with the fox family, but finally realizes they're robots and rescues Tails.

An elderly, out of shape, overweight superhero keeps trying to help Sonic battle Dr. Robotnik, and keeps getting him in more jepordy. Sonic helps the old hero regain his self respect and they team up to battle Robotnik's latest scheme.

After an accident, Scratch thinks he's an eagle and on the side of Sonic. In order to impress his his new lady love, Scratch assists Sonic in an excursion into Robotnik's Fortress to turn off a dangerous force field.
Sonic turns detective to solve the mystery of his missing Red Sneakers--and just in time to get them back and stop Dr. Robotnik's latest attack on a peaceful Mobius village.
Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him.
Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strenghs.
Mobius is suffering a crime spree and all the evidence points to Sonic as the culprit. But the real thief is a lab rat wearing a high-tech vehicle suit who was sent by Robotnik to discredit our hero.
When Hacker, an adolescent mole computer whiz steals a super-intelligence program from Robotnik's computer, Sonic has to protect him, smashing Grounder to pieces.

When Uncle Chuck's "bug" reveals Robotnik's search for the legendary Deep Power Stones, he informs Sally, who tries to retrieve data regarding the Royal Family Secret. But she's denied access via a time-encoded lock-out.
After Antoine saves Sally's life during a raid, Sonic can't stand his bragging and zips in to see Uncle Chuck, who finds out his "bug" in Robotnik's HQ is malfunctioning.

The guys find a bag of money and they want to split it up right away. But Arnold strongly suggests the honest route "to turn the money into the police and keep it if no one claims it."

programmes.st: New Bully On The Block/Phoebe Breaks A Leg
programmes.d: When a new bully comes on the block, Wolfgang feels threatened that he will lose his power over Arnold and the gang. Phoebe breaks her leg when she rescues Helga from the pathway of a speeding bus.

programmes.st: Stuck In A Tree/Rhonda Goes Broke
programmes.d: Arnold tries to help Eugene get out of a tree but gets stuck himself. After a busy day at school of boasting and fashion policing, Rhonda comes home and finds out that they are now broke and have nothing left.

Helga loses her infamous locket and it winds up in the wrong place in Arnold's house. Sid learns that germs are on just about everything people touch and becomes so psychotic about hygiene that he wears a protective suit.

During a game of baseball, Arnold pops a fly ball and it hits Helga in the head. The knock on the head makes her goofy and causes amnesia. Grandpa is paid a visit by his old friend Jimmy, which sparks up his competitive nature.

As the gang passes through the cemetery, Gerald tells the story of the Ghost Bride who murdered her husband-to-be when he left her at the alter and married her sister. Gerald meets Chloe, a cute girl on his block, and instantly falls head over heels.

Harold decides that he hates school and wants nothing else to do with it. But when he gets suspended and can find nothing to do at home, he tries everything he can to go back. Ernie falls in love with a beautiful magazine model.

Arnold pays his cousin Arnie a visit and it turns out to be much like being in The Twilight Zone. Wolfgang tells Chocolate Boy that if he can go two weeks without chocolate, he'll give him ten pounds of chocolate.

programmes.st: Harold And Patty Arm Wrestle/Arnold And The Rich Guy
programmes.d: Harold becomes the King Of Arm Wrestling at PS 118. At a hockey game with Grandpa, Arnold prevents an airborne puck from hitting a stranger in the head.

The Racing Mule/Curly's Girl: Mr. Hyuhn, Ernie and Oskar combine their resources to purchase a racing horse. When Rhonda's dad buys her mother a fur coat for her birthday, the temptation is too great and Rhonda wears it to school.

On The Lam/Family Man: Harold, Stinky, and Sid steal rockets out of the science lab at school and set them off outside an old police station. The deli shop where Mr. Hyunh works has a new owner, and he's looking for a new head chef.

Its date night at the Palm Woods. James helps Carlos on his date with one of the Jennifers, Kendall joins Lucy’s dinner with her parents, and Logan takes a blind date out so he can spy on Camille's date with Jett.

Griffin is pitching a line of BTR merchandise to the CEO of Selmart, but the boys hate the products. Taking matters into their own hands the guys crash the meeting and accidently get their music banned from Selmart stores.
Kendall and Lucy are about to have their first kiss when her good looking ex-boyfriend Beau shows up to win her back. Griffin recruits Logan and Carlos to help him prepare for corporate espionage.
Kendall is ready to ask out Lucy, but Jo unexpectedly shows up and Kendall has to decide which girl is the one for him. Meanwhile Carlos and James’ friendship is put to the test.

Kendall and Logan must take care of Rocque Records' newest artist – an out-of-it rock legend until his induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame that night. James and Carlos are stuck babysitting Katie.

The guys want to go camping, but Gustavo nixes the idea because it’s dangerous. Instead they use their connections to camp on a sound stage, but things go awry as the guys try to show off their roughing it skills.

Kendall and Logan volunteer at a dog shelter and end up adopting 12 dogs, but a sneaky heath inspector is on to them. Carlos and Jennifer’s puppy love is sickening and it’s up to James and the other Jennifers to rescue them.

Kendall buys Jo a gold necklace to show that he’s committed, but Camille thinks Logan bought it for her. Gustavo hangs BTR’s new gold record and Carlos and James wonder what would happen if they played it.

The guys accidentally destroy the tape of the new Big Time Rush episode they were supposed to give the network. Needing a replacement episode the guys decide to make a blooper show which Stephen Glickman and Ciara Bravo host.

Big Time Invasion: BTR has to stop the invasion of the British boy band! Concerned that Gustavo is spread too thin, the boys try to hire a top music manager. Unable to agree, the four split and a rift quickly escalates within the band.

Lucy releases her revenge album about Kendall and it becomes a huge hit! James, desperate for attention, creates a rumor that he and Cher Lloyd are recording a duet, and Carlos gets bad press after he appears to hit an old lady.

The guys are caught in a web of lies. Kendall has to keep Jo from discovering Lucy has returned to the Palm Woods. Logan’s fib about being sick turns into a medical emergency and Carlos and James claim Rocque Records was robbed.
Big Time Bonus: Gustavo gives the guys a bonus for their hard work, but they quickly begin to make bad decisions with their money.

BTR is making a cameo on a popular kid’s TV show, but Carlos’ pursuit of the show’s teen star puts him and Kendall in the crosshairs of her evil stage mother. Logan & James battle Yo Gabba Gabba over their amazing snack table.
It’s time again for the prank war at the Palm Woods, and this time it's kids versus adults as they battle for the honor of winning Lord Prankington’s Cup.

James continues his pursuit of Lucy and buys a motorcycle in order to impress her, but he doesn’t know how to drive it. Kendall teaches Jo how to drive stick-shift, and Carlos & Logan can’t relinquish a childhood treasure.
Logan brings Carlos along to the MCAT test as his good luck charm, but when Carlos somehow gets a higher score, Logan questions his plans to become a doctor.
The guys are pitched a kids cartoon show but instead do a video game to expand their brand. A mix-up while wearing motion capture suits puts them at the center of an extraterrestrial news story.
After being told that boy bands always split up after the third album, the guys compete to find solo “breakout” gigs before being left behind.

BTR is on tour with Victoria Justice and we go inside the guys’ bus to see the craziness that happens on board. When the guys get stuck in traffic, it is up to Victoria to keep the concert audience entertained until they arrive.

Big Time Dreams Pt. 1: It’s the Tween Choice Awards, and BTR is nominated and booked to close the show!  However, their night is in jeopardy when the guys uncover an evil plan to brainwash the audience.
It’s the Tween Choice Awards, and BTR is nominated and booked to close the show! However, their night is in jeopardy when the guys uncover an evil plan to brainwash the audience.

Kendall, James, Logan and Carlos are hockey playing best friends from Minnesota, whose lives are turned upside down after mega-record producer discovers them and moves them to Los Angeles to make them into the next big boy band.

Kendall, Carlos, James, and Logan are required to attend four hours at school. However, instead of going to school at the Palmwoods Hotel, which they all have their own fantasies about, Gustavo insists that they attend school at his recording studio.
The four 'hockey heads' need some home improvement for their new apartment, despite the objections of Reginald Bitters, the Palm Woods manager.
The guys get a dose of reality when Gustavo tells them they have to go to school while they live in Los Angeles.

The record company CEO thinks adding a fifth band member will broaden Big Time Rush’s appeal and sticks the guys with a self-proclaimed 'bad boy', who tries to inject dissension and tension within the group.
The guys all chase the same girl, causing problems in the band for the first time.

When Gustavo has to go away on business, he lets the guys house-sit his mansion. While the boys do their best to keep the house in pristine condition, they inevitably destroy everything inside that Gustavo values.
The pressure is on as the guys prepare for their first band photo, which could land them into all the teen magazines.
Spending all their time together since moving to LA has given guys cabin fever, so they decide to spend some time apart.
It's been three months since the boys of Big Time Rush moved to Hollywood to record their demos. Now it's up to Griffin to decide the future of the band.
After learning that Gustavo is hosting a party at the studio that the boys are not invited to, they guys decide to host their own party at the Palm Woods.
The guys are continuing to live their Hollywood dream, however James, Logan & Carlos begin showing odd behavior.
The guys have been having a little too much fun living in Hollywood and after getting charged again for breaking stuff at the Palm Woods and Gustavo has had enough and makes them get jobs!

Gustavo needs a place to stay since his mansion is being fumigated and Mom invites him to stay at the Crib. At the same time there is some sort of 'Paranormal Activity' taking place at the Palm Woods.

When the enormous monster descends upon New York, it's up to the Army and an odd team of investigators to unravel the mystery behind the incredible creature before it's too late.

Dr. Phil takes goes inside the unthinkable: making your own child sick to fulfill a disturbing need for attention. The idea might sound unimaginable, but for people with a psychological disorder called Munchausen by Proxy, it's irresistible.

What happens when a parent's agenda becomes so extreme that his or her children are forced to live a harsh, stoic existence?

Pat Gray pulls no punches and restores common sense to a senseless world through biting analysis, unique insight and fun.
A good Samaritan who takes action against a criminal terrorizing the subway has the Reagans pondering the rights and wrongs of vigilantism.
With a bomb set to detonate in Manhattan, Frank, Danny, and the rest of the NYPD search for its whereabouts. In the midst of the search, the Reagans argue the merits and downfalls of profiling.
Erin's family debates her methods when she uses a law-abiding citizen as bait to take down his gang leader brother.
Erin, Frank, and Danny work together within the system to find justice when a rape case's primary suspect is protected by diplomatic immunity.
Frank mobilizes the entire NYPD to find the killer of an off-duty police officer who was murdered during a diamond heist.
Danny works to discover the source of a deadly narcotic after three teenagers die from a drug overdose.
After witnessing a crime in progress, Jamie's suspect is killed in the pursuit. Danny must solve the case to clear Jamie's name and keep IA from a full-blown investigation.
Three released prison inmates place the Reagan family in danger.
While Danny investigates the murder of a popular nightclub's doorman, Frank gets information that his ex-partner is covering up crimes.
A 25-year-old cold case of Frank's is brought to the forefront when the missing boy's remains are found. Danny and Jackie look into the death of a high-end escort.
Because it involves classified information and a sleeper cell, Frank assigns Danny to cover the shooting of an undercover counter-terrorism agent.
When the son of a Russian gangster is killed at his own engagement party, Danny delves into the world of the Russian mob. Meanwhile, Erin is thrown into a high-profile corruption case.
A drug addict becomes the prime focus of Danny and Jackie's investigation after his girlfriend is kidnapped and held for ransom. Erin and Charles move past the flirting stage.
Is someone out to assassinate the Commissioner or was the shooting random? Danny takes on the assignment to find out the answer.
Nicky rides along with Danny to a crime scene where a girl at a debutante ball has been murdered and she has a difficult time coping after seeing her first murder victim.
As a former Marine, Danny feels personally responsible for finding the killer of a former U.S. Marine war hero. Someone has leaked false information to the press that Frank is going to run for mayor.
Just before Danny is to give witness testimony at a Peruvian drug lord's murder trial, Linda is kidnapped. This drug lord has a history of intimidating witnesses.
When Joe and his friend Mitch go after a puma, Joe climbs a big peak and throws his gun up higher, intending to crawl up after it.
Hoss relies on clever attorney Whitney Parker, who has a drinking problem, to clear him of a murder charge.

Two robberies take place on stagecoaches that Adam is traveling on, and both times a knight in shining armor scares the robbers away.  Adam is accused of robbery, and his story about the knight is none too helpful.

Hoss unknowingly enters a flapjack contest and Joe puts Hoss on a diet which Hoss doesn't care for.  Joe's betting on the flapjack contest could get him into some trouble and will he ever succeed in getting the window pane his Pa wants?

Little Joe convinces Ben to hire Harry Starr, a half-Indian who is accused by other ranchers of being a chronic horse thief. Joe sets out to prove the others wrong, but is the youngest Cartwright's trust misplaced?
A peaceful Indian is framed for the kidnapping of a young girl, a stunt which ends of tragedy.

On their way to prevent a young woman from encountering the renegade Indians, Joe and Tuck are captured, and in order to save them all, Joe must fight Sharp Tongue, who is the leader of the band who went to school with Joe as a youth.
Professor Klump and Amanda pull Hoss into their flying machine scheme. The ""Hoss-mobile""doesn't seem to be destined for a great take-off.

Ben's friend, Don Miguel, visits the Ponderosa with his two daughters, Margarita and Elena, and Elena's two very anxious suitors.  Their mission? They're on their way to California to meet Margarita's suitor, Don Luis.

Kellie Conrad dances and her father plays the fiddle to earn a living.  Hoss feels a sense of guilt after he unintentionally hurts the arm that Kellie's father uses to play the fiddle, in a saloon fight with some roughnecks.

Hoss' latest acquaintance, an Englishman named Professor Poppy, is actually Percival Alexander Mundy, M.D., who has given up the practice of medicine.  However, when Hoss is shot in the back, only Mundy's skill can save his life.
Adam becomes involved with a quick-triggered range detective hired by the Virginia City Cattleman's Association to find out who is responsible for all the rustling going on in the area.
Adam sets out to track down the man who has been impersonating him to clear his reputation.
While working as a substitute teacher, Adam uncovers an ugly secret about the territory's past that others prefer remain hidden.
The Cartwrights play host to Guido Borelli, a world renowed aerial acrobat who once saved Ben's life in Italy.  Borelli's troup is beset by internal strife, and is performing in Virginia City.
Cousin Muley Jones returns to the Ponderosa, along with a pack of noisy hound dogs, in this funny sequel to "The Saga Of Muley Jones".
First Ben's sons are making lots of noise, so he goes into town to sleep in the hotel. Then, various noises and things interrupt Ben's sleep.  Will he ever get his desired good night's rest?

programmes.t: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Blood Prison (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Naruto's convicted of a crime he didn’t commit and is sent to the prison, Hozuki Castle.

programmes.t: The Last: Naruto the Movie (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: The moon approaches dangerously close! Naruto and friends set out to investigate.
A foe lies in wait as Sasuke, the Five Kage and Boruto, charge into another dimension!
Boruto Uzumaki, the son of the village leader, saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on by bullies.
After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time.
After getting caught in a fight between Metal and Shikadai, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

programmes.st: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
programmes.d: At the suggestion of Shino Aburame, their homeroom teacher, Boruto and his classmates split off into gendered teams to capture flags placed on the roof.
A mysterious student named Mitsuki has transferred into Boruto's class from Hidden Sound Village.
Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does, and Shino suddenly attacks them!
Cho-Cho's scared because she thinks she's being watched by someone, so she decides to catch them in the act.
A Visual Jutsu places Boruto within a dream, and afterward, Boruto declares the dream has awakened his Byakugan, the Kekkei Genkai unique to his mother's Hyuga Clan.
Under his father and grandfather's guidance, Boruto spars with his aunt Hanabi. No matter how hard he tries, he can’t activate his Byakugan in any form.

programmes.st: The Ghost Incident: The Investigation Begins!
programmes.d: Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow "The Ghost" and is excited when he and his friends Shikadai and Mitsuki decide to solve the recent "Ghost Incidents."
During a tour of workplaces for their school assignment, Sumire, Wasabi Izuno and Namida Suzumeno get wrapped up in the Ghost Incident and are hurt.
The Ghost incidents suddenly come to an end and Boruto and his classmates are puzzled, but Mitsuki seems to know something they don't.
Seventh Hokage Naruto and his top advisors are shocked to learn who the perpetrator is from the results of Sai's investigation. Just then, Nue, an enormous otherworldly beast, appears!

programmes.st: The Path That Boruto Can See
programmes.d: The late Danzo Shimura was the founder and leader of the Foundation, an elite branch of the ANBU Black Ops. The recent incidents have been masterminded by someone who had sworn to carry on Danzo's wishes.
The ghost incident that threatened the Hidden Leaf Village is over, and now Boruto is unable to awaken the mysterious power he used.
Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.

programmes.st: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
programmes.d: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions.
Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her.

A suspect's infatuation with Catherine results in her taking over a high-profile case.
The sheriff is under political pressure to find who killed an air marshal with a car bomb that the sheriff witnessed.
A teenager is found murdered on a construction site. Grissom, Sara, and Warrick follow the lead of blood on a hammer.
The lone holdout on a jury is found dead in the jury room. The eleven jurors who were voting guilty and who hated the dead juror are the natural suspects.
A woman found murdered in her home. Her resemblance to Sara causes Grissom to take a personal interest in the case and forces him to examine the decisions he has made in his life.
Grissom, Sara, and Nick respond to an electrocution at a casino. The casino is hosting Japanese antiquities. The electrocution is just a ruse to steal the central piece of the exhibit.
A robbery at a grocery store results in a shootout leaving five dead. The police officer at the scene believes Grissom has a grudge against him.
The whole team must investigate a crime where a husband and his porn star wife were murdered execution-style.
Catherine and Sara deal with the death of what at first seems to be a transvestite.

A mutilated female body is discovered tied to the undercarriage of a bus carrying prisoners from a women's correctional facility after a severed arm flies out from beneath the vehicle and strikes a car.
A violent murder in a casino parking garage and another episode in the police interview room lead the CSIs to one shocking discovery after another.

Warrick, Catherine, and Nick try to determine the cause of a house fire that kills a teenage girl. The fire is in the same neighborhood as a similar arson fire. Grissom and Sara investigate a man found dead with letter tiles in his stomach.

Grissom, Catherine, and Nick investigate the death of a runner during a competition. Meanwhile, Sara and Warrick investigate the death of a couple in a hotel room, initially thought to be a murder-suicide.
A roller coaster runs off its track, leaving six people dead. The CSI team investigates whether this was an accident or foul play.
Two young men are found murdered after scamming Sam Braun's casinos.
A casino employee is beaten and raped on her way home from work, but she survives and identifies her attacker.

A feverish night in Las Vegas results in one dead male in an alien suit, one more dead male in a bathtub, one dead female with two suspicous men at the scene, and another dead male with a polaroid of yet another dead male.
Horatio and the team race against time to find out who is trying to frame Horatio for the murder of a woman he’s been dating.
When a "wives weekend" ends in murder, the CSI team is faced with three women whose separate trysts with the victim make them prime suspects
The team works in tandem with NY CSI chief Mac Taylor to apprehend a serial killer before he kills the young girl he has just taken hostage
Ryan Wolfe is attacked and seriously injured while investigating the murder of a distraught soon-to-be ex-wife, and there is no shortage of suspects.
Horatio and the CSI team must rely on a video game for their next clue as to where a group of young gunmen will strike next.
The CSI team is hard-pressed to find the killer of an infamous drug lord, and a member of the team is investigated for drugs by Internal Affairs.
A rapist is brutally murdered after his identity is exposed.  Horatio and the CSI team are called in to investigate the murder.
Horatio and the CSI team investigate a group of male “pickup artists” out to score when one of them unexpectedly turns up dead.
Miami’s Latin Festival shifts from Samba to somber when a crowded dance floor becomes the scene of a gang member.  Horatio and the team investigate.
A bizarre murder of a South Beach club owner turns out to be a script where art is imitating life.  Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
Horatio’s longtime criminal nemesis Walter Resden surfaces once again, and Caine is determined to finally bring him to justice.
Alex campaigns against a sex offender who moves into her neighborhood and then becomes embroiled in controversy when the man is murdered soon thereafter.
What begins as a case of apparent Road Rage leads the CSI team to the investigation of a stolen $4 million necklace, which is tied to a murder.
When a white supremacist is acquitted for the murder of his wife after learning she is racially mixed, it’s up to Horatio to bring the killer down.
A band of masked gunmen invade an upscale spa, with the female customers' luxury cars as their booty. A customer is injured in the melee.
The bodies of two men, shot execution-style, are discovered in an abandoned hotel slated for demolition. Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
A cell phone call leads the team to investigate a kidnapping that, unless they reach the victim before it’s too late, could soon become a murder.
When a couple is found beaten in their home, the CSIs think they have the suspect after a mother ID's her son, but all is not what it seems.
When a powerful gang leader is murdered, the CSI New York team of investigators must find the killer before a street war breaks out.
A jewel heist at the penthouse of one of New York's most powerful attorneys takes a bizarre turn as the case leads the CSIs to a man in the morgue.
The CSI New York team of investigators finds a body on a rooftop and must find the killer who is manipulating crime scenes.
With a sniper lose in New York City, Mac must relive an abduction case that might have created one of the city's deadliest foes.
The CSI New York team of investigators experience eerie occurrences after a woman is found who has literally been scared to death.
Mac goes up against the deputy chief of detectives when a dark secret from the chief's past threatens his reputation and family.
Mac and the CSI New York team search for the killer of a department store manager found dead in a holiday display window.
When a man in full clown costume shoots a bakery owner, the CSIs investigate and discover a decision from Flack's past that may put him in jeopardy.
When a Spanish club promoter is found dead, Detective Mac Taylor must battle with the head of Barcelona's crime lab to solve the case.
When a tractor-trailer carrying party guests mysteriously ends up at the bottom of the Hudson River, the CSIs must exhume the soggy remains.
When the CSIs track down a suave and charming hitman, their investigation uncovers a conspiracy with far-reaching implications.
When a serial rapist is murdered, restrained in the same manner as his victims, the CSIs weigh a feeling of justice against their sense of duty.
When a conspiracy-obsessed woman is found dead, the CSIs investigate and discover that some of her theories may have had some truth to them.
When a popular student at Manhattan's most elite private school is murdered, the CSIs find themselves in the competitive world of the overprivileged.
Jo balances personal and professional challenges when her adopted daughter, Ellie, is the key witness in a murder investigation.
The team enters the competitive world of gourmet food trucks when one explodes at a SoHo food festival while Hawkes is there with his girlfriend.
Cody Rhodes presents the Dusty Cup to the winning tag team. CM Punk challenges NXT Champion Grayson Waller. John Cena makes an appearance.
Vanity Project defend the NXT Tag Team Title against Dusty Cup winners Noam Dar & Romeo Moreno. Izzi Dame collides with Wren Sinclair.
NXT goes Hollywood with New Year's Evil from Los Angeles.
OTM challenge Fraxiom for the NXT Tag Team Title.
NXT Champion Oba Femi faces his first challenger in Eddy Thorpe.

NXT's newest Superstar signs a historic contract amongst chaos.
NXT's newest signing Ricky Saints makes his in-ring debut.
Shawn Spears aims to begin his takeover of NXT by attempting to dethrone NXT North American Champion Tony D'Angelo.

programmes.st: We All Scream For Ice Cream
programmes.d: Prue has a melody in her head and when she sees a girl humming the tune, she finds that it belongs to the ice-cream truck.
The sisters must stop a warlock from executing his plan to steal specific powers from witches in his attempt to kill every whitelighter in the world.
When Prue discovers that one of her ex-boyfriends is being led down the path to becoming a demon, she, Piper and Phoebe risk their lives in an underworld wrestling ring to save his soul.
Phoebe and Piper are lured to the dark side and relish their new evil powers when a shapeshifting warlock tricks Prue into a shot-gun wedding in an effort to steal the Book of Shadows.

programmes.st: The Good, The Bad & The Cursed
programmes.d: Phoebe somehow becomes psychically and physically linked with the violent past of an Old West ghost town complete with horses, petticoats, cowboys and six-shooters and Prue must go back in time to save her sister from a horrifying fate.

Piper is praying for a demon-free wedding day, but Prue's astral self has other plans as dreams take her into a wild world without rules and responsibility that affect reality when the police arrest Prue on suspicion of murder.

Prue is tired of losing her battle to save innocents, and in her effort to fight off the Angel of Death, she has to turn her back on a dying soul when she accepts that she can't fight fate and reconciles with the death of her mother.

Piper and Leo feel lack of privacy and decide to move to a rented apartment. When they tell Prue and Phoebe, the Halliwell sisters recall their troubled relationship with their grandmother Penny before they acknowledge that they were The Charmed Ones
A demon wielding the seven deadly sins uses his powers against The Charmed Ones, and after only a few hours exposed to Pride, Gluttony, Lust and Sloth, Phoebe, Prue, Piper, and Leo may self-destruct.

programmes.st: The Demon Who Came In From The Cold
programmes.d: Cole officially joins the good fight when he goes undercover in an underworld brotherhood to help Prue, Phoebe, Piper, and Leo learn more about the evil. Their trust in him falters when it looks as though they are being double-crossed.

Phoebe is worried when her love, Cole stays undercover in a demon Brotherhood, but the danger turns dire when Cole's old mentor plots to bring out his evil side and turn his massive powers against the Charmed Ones.
Piper is trying to control her new power, while Phoebe is writing in the Book of Shadows about Cole. Prue is worried with the behavior of Phoebe and also missing a nice boyfriend.

Prue and Piper bring Dr. Griffiths to their home to save him from the Source's assassin Shax. While Phoebe looks in the Book of Shadows how to vanquish the demon, Prue and Piper fight and chase Shax on the streets to destroy him.
Piper and Phoebe are faced with the loss of Prue, whilst The Source discovers why the Power of Three has not been severed by Prue's death.
Piper is full of anger for the death of Prue and vanquishing as many demons as possible, jeopardizing her, Phoebe, and Cole's lives.
While investigating a creepy old house, Paige involves the Charmed Ones with a demon named Gamil and are all shrunk to a height of five inches.

Carla shows up at her ex-husband's wedding with Sam as her date.
Sam questions Norm's abilities when he hires him as an accountant.
Diane and Sam try to get Coach out of their hair by arranging a double date.
A man in the bar becomes sick of Cliff's obnoxious know-it-all behavior and challenges him to a fight. Will Cliff shut up, accept the challenge, or run away?
Coach brings fortunes to Cheers when he buys an antique scale.
Diane forbids Sam to go on an annual ski trip with his buddies.

Norm tries to prove his manliness when his new client makes advances.
Sam hires a brilliant artist to paint Diane as a peace offering.
Diane defends her relationship with Sam to a slandering artist.

After several sessions with Dr. Frasier Crane, Sam is getting his life back in order, so Diane feels it's time to tell him the truth about her relationship with the psychiatrist.
Sam gloats when he has reason to believe that Diane is still in love with him.
Frasier asks Sam to escort Diane to an event while he is out of town.
Sam reaps the consequences of getting involved with a married woman.
Coach proposes marriage when he falls in love at first sight.
After Coach's girlfriend Irene wins the lottery, she becomes a socialite and breaks up with him.
Frasier's mom threatens Diane's life when they meet for the first time.
Carla's ex-husband returns with his new bride, demanding custody of their oldest son. The normally feisty Carla shocks everyone at the bar when she agrees to the request.
After moving in with Frasier, Diane develops a chronic allergy and believes his beloved dog, Pavlov, causes it.
Norm decides to live life to the fullest when he gets back his medical test results.
At the bar, Sam's innocent flirtation with an attractive customer, Amanda, gets him into trouble when he doesn't realize she's a member of Diane's therapy group.
Carla wins the favor and admiration of Frasier's esteemed mentor.

Sam volunteers to play in a charity softball game against Playboy Playmates.
Sam gets Coach's help to help him pass a geography class and get his high school diploma. But he eventually finds an easier way to pass the course.
Norm jeopardizes Cliff's job when he covers his route for a day.
An old bet forces Sam to choose between getting married or losing Cheers.
An astute reporter visits Cheers and is turned off by Sam's arrogance.

programmes.st: If I Ever Would Leave You
programmes.d: Nick returns to win back Carla's love when his new wife leaves him.
Norm's forced to take a promotion that entails firing employees.
With much trepidation, Diane decides to leave Cheers and travel to Europe with Frasier, who has been offered a temporary position at the University of Bologna.

Anne Burrell and Bobby Flay teach how to build flavors by experimenting.
Anne Burrell and Bobby Flay teach the recruits how to cook quantity.
Two surprise house guests want the most important meal of the day.
To make it to the finale, the final four must cook in a blind taste test.
The two finalists cook in a professional restaurant kitchen for experts.
New kid on the block Tyler Florence joins Anne Burrell in Worst Cooks.
Anne Burrell and Tyler test the recruits' knowledge of food through trivia.

The final recruits battle to be named the winner and take home $25,000.
Anne and Tyler choose 14 home cooks for culinary boot camp.
Anne and Tyler test the recruits' food knowledge with a game show battle.
The recruits taste unlikely flavor combinations and face the Skill Drill.
Anne and Tyler give the recruits a hard lesson in kitchen multi-tasking.
The recruits make exotic burgers and learn to fillet a whole cod.
The four recruits face the last Skill Drill and cook for their loved ones.
The final recruits battle to see which cook has gone from worst to best.
The new recruits learn fast that boot camp is no walk down the red carpet.
The guys build a well house and repair a water-damaged log home.

programmes.d: The team takes the 100-percent cabin and rebuilds it as a hunting cabin.
The guys reclaim a double-pen barn, and Mark visits a finished lodge.
The guys use three centuries of materials to create a custom pavilion.
The crew heads to Gatlinburg, TN, to build a cabin in the Smoky Mountains.
The guys help a widower build the cabin that he and his late wife chose.
The guys build a barnwood dance floor and more for a farm wedding.
The Barnwood Builders take on one of their toughest takedowns ever.
The guys stop in Paducah, KY, to save a little cabin in a big quarry.
The team visits Pennsylvania to disassemble a 150-year-old carriage house.
Mark and the guys build a barnwood-style cabin on a foldable steel frame.
The guys turn a brand new storage shed into an 1800s log cabin.
Mark and the guys build a cabin using barn beams instead of logs.
Mark restores the barnwood from a bank barn for his client's restaurant.

programmes.st: Barnwood Gold Mine in the Keystone State
programmes.d: Mark and the guys uncover a perfectly preserved Pennsylvania bank barn.
The team heads to Paris, TX, to turn an 1800s cabin into a bridal suite.
An old project finds a home in Texas to match a client's favorite painting.

programmes.st: Building the New England Barn in South Carolina
programmes.d: The guys rebuild a massive New England timber frame in South Carolina.
The crew takes the week off to work on projects in their own backyards.
Mark and the guys save the logs from a fire-damaged home in West Virginia.
Mark and the guys take beams from a massive barn in Schuylkill County, PA.
The guys salvage five barns in Alton, VA, and Mark hunts for more in PA.
Set in Paris' famous Red Light district, a rookie policeman (Jack Lemmon) plots to keep a beautiful prostitute (Shirley MacLaine) all to himself in this hit comedy from director Billy Wilder.

This Oscar®-nominated film has the legendary Cary Grant as a government attorney who can't seem to shake his bad fortune. Living on a houseboat, widowed and left with three unruly kids, he hires Sophia Loren as a governess.

Two divorced men decide to share a New York apartment. Fussy Felix, fastidious to a fault.  He proves that cleanliness is next to insanity.  And Oscar, who wreaks havoc on a tidy room with the speed and thoroughness of a tornado.
Jack Lemmon, Shirley MacLaine and Fred MacMurray are superb in this tale of love and ambition in the world of big business that went on to garner a Best Picture Oscar.

This hysterical comedy from director Billy Wilder finds Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon masquerading as women in order to elude irate Chicago mobsters while befriending a beautiful singer (Marilyn Monroe).

Intense, enthralling, and unforgettable, Sunset Boulevard stars Gloria Swanson as Norma Desmond, a faded silent-movie star, and William Holden as Joe Gillis, a down-on-his-luck screenwriter whom she enlists to help her make her triumphant return.

Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.
The glorious epic style of Cecil B. DeMille is exemplified in this story of the Bible's legendary strongman and the woman who seduces, then betrays him.
Oscar tries to cure Felix of his fear of flying so he can cover a major photographic assignment.
Rob feels very much the hero when he hires a maid for his overworked wife, Laura.

programmes.st: The Sound of the Trumpets of Conscience Falls Deafly on a Brain That Holds Its Ears...
programmes.d: Rob struggles between his civic duty and fear for his family's safety when he believes he can identify the two robbers in a jewelry store holdup.
It's the first Christmas presentation of 'The Alan Brady Show' where he turns the spotlight upon his talented staff to entertain the TV public.

programmes.st: The Third One from the Left
programmes.d: A young chorus girl on 'The Alan Brady Show' falls desperately in love with Rob.

programmes.st: My Husband Is the Best One
programmes.d: Rob's job is threatened by a news article praising him more than Alan for the success of 'The Alan Brady Show.'

programmes.st: The Lady and the Tiger and the Lawyer
programmes.d: When a handsome bachelor moves in next door, Rob and Laura become matchmakers.

programmes.st: The Life and Love of Joe Coogan
programmes.d: Rob is overwhelmed by jealousy when he meets one of Laura's old flames and later discovers that she saved a box of love poems he sent her.

programmes.st: A Nice, Friendly Game of Cards
programmes.d: A social game of poker turns sour when it's discovered Rob has been playing with a marked deck.

programmes.st: Happy Birthday and Too Many More
programmes.d: When Laura and Rob give Ritchie a birthday party, 63 screaming kids cause a ruckus at the Petrie house.
Rob consults a psychiatrist to determine whether a series of mysterious ailments are psychosomatic.
Socialite Clara Watkins is an important guest at Shady Rest. Unless she recommends the place to her friends, the bank won't lend Kate any more money.
Everyone seems too busy to spend any time with Charley, so he decides to quit his job as engineer of the Hooterville Cannonball.
Railroad President Norman Curtis thinks that his household's pet basset hound needs a change of scenery, so he sends the dog off to Shady Rest.
Kate Bradley is visited by an old schoolmate who's now a millionaire, but Uncle Joe has him pegged as a con artist.
Homer Bedloe returns to Hooterville with his son, Homer Junior, who is as hateful and devious as his father.
Business executive Mary Jane Hastings returns home to Hooterville and impresses everyone with her administrative ability, particularly her handling of men.
Shady Rest would stand a better chance of being selected as the site of the big convention if Kate were around, but she's trapped in a cave-in.
Kate is trying to get Shady Rest chosen as the site for a big convention, but a sprained ankle has incapacitated her and the job of cornering the convention is left to Uncle Joe and the daughters.
When Adelaide "Genghis" Keane returns from Europe, Kate is surprised to find that the elderly schoolteacher is no longer the tyrannical disciplinarian she used to be.
Folks at the Shady Rest hotel find Betty Jo extremely changed after a trip to Europe[her graduation present].

Gomer wins a trip for two to Las Vegas and takes Sergeant Carter with him. The Sergeant has no money so he has to rely on Gomer for entertainment but Gomer has set an itinerary which include things like visiting a Rock Museum.
Opie Taylor runs away from Mayberry to join the Marines.

programmes.st: A Date with Miss Camp Henderson
programmes.d: A bet between sergeants and Sergeant Carter's lies result in Gomer dating Miss Camp Henderson and taking her to Lookout Point.
Both Gomer and Sergeant Carter are conned by an old bum.

Sergeant Carter takes a temporary desk job writing training manuals and considers making it permanent when he sees the platoon does fine without him; so Gomer messes things up to bring the Sergeant back.

Sergeant Carter is in a restaurant with a girl other than his girlfriend when he foils an armed robbery. The Sergeant doesn't want his girlfriend to know he was there with another woman so he pins the credit on Gomer.
Gomer gets his first shot at the obstacle course.
Gomer helps a recruit smuggle his girlfriend into the barracks.
While on a hike Gomer makes a friend, but when the friend decides to move into the barracks Sgt Carter wants him gone! but Gomer shows the sergeant what an asset this new friend is to the platoon.
After tipping his hat instead of saluting female Captain "Iron Pants" Martin, Gomer is assigned special detail in her office to teach him a lesson.

Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fiancé stood him up at the alter on their big day.
A salesman attending a convention wrongly believes that he is responsible for the death of an attractive female hitchhiker who had lured him to her houseboat.
Mannix helps his carnival owner friend find out if any of the workers are causing accidents that might be attempts on her life.
The lovely niece of a Korean War veteran is killed with a blow to her neck, and Mannix looks at evidence that suggests an ex-member of his old army unit murdered her.

Someone has been making threatening telephone calls to Joe Mannix, and this mysterious person begins to take shots at him, too -- one of which cuts down Joe's friend Barry Nolan, who runs the photography shop across from Joe's office.
Mannix is hired by the sister of Geoffrey Paradine, a college student who has disappeared. As the episode opens, Mannix is taken off the case because she claims to have found him.
A group of prisoners on death row in a prison near Lawson City stage a takeover, taking as a hostage a guard named Charlie Keefer, who is a friend of Joe Mannix.
Danny Williams' passion was rekindled by his high school sweetheart Mellissa Cole, charged with shoplifting. Life is complicated when she is linked to a neurotic murderer sought by McGarrett.

When a prominent Canadian businessman, registered under an assumed name at a Waikiki Hotel, is the victim of a hit-and-run accident, Steve McGarrett is faced with one of the most bizarre cases in the history of the Five-0 unit.
When a man attempts to assassinate a hypnotically compelling evangelist, it is discovered that the threatening weapon is an unloaded gun, Steve McGarrett's interest is more than piqued.

Ray Santoro, a member of the Kumu, kills Bernie Adams, a member of the mainland syndicate, in order to force his way into a partnership with an unwilling Sonny Kanekoa, the owner of a flourishing discotheque.
Johnny Munroe defends a young singer from the takeover by Ray Santoro and aligns with mainland mob boss Allie Francis. Francis is excited about island business opportunities.

Steve McGarrett's skill and instincts are matched against an impossible crime. Money is stolen from a fortress-like, burglar-proof Honolulu bank built by Matthew Meighan. The impossible has happened, and McGarrett and his Five-O unit are stumped.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: After his nephew Matt almost dies from a drug overdose, Bubba Skinner travels to Atlanta, Georgia to help him overcome his addiction to heroin. While investigating Matt’s drug supplier, he teams up with an undercover detective, Walker Harris.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Sergeant LuAnn Corbin takes temporary custody of an abandoned baby boy found at a crack house after a drive-by shooting is reported in the Bottoms. When the infant’s young mother, a crack addict, comes to reclaim the boy, LuAnn struggles to let go.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Tragedy strikes Sparta when a young alcoholic woman, Holly Maynard, kills a child, Denia Larson, in a hit-and-run accident; however, a second and unexpected tragedy sadly follows, which will expose certain tragic failures of the justice system.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Marissa and David, interracial sweethearts at Sparta High School, are targeted by a racist sniper who takes a shot at Marissa. Many people in town assume that David was the real target, because he’s Black, but then why was only one shot taken?

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Parker Williams is shocked to find his ex-fiancée, Beverly Ross, at a drug deal, but he’s even more shocked when Beverly accuses him of using excessive force during the arrest. He claims it was self-defense, but Beverly is sticking to her story.
A friendly-fire incident involving a veteran cop leaves Steve's friend dead, but the shooting only appears to be unintentional.
Jesse and Dr. Sloan have contact with a contagious victim of a genetically altered smallpox strain.
Walker tracks down crooked geneticists who have kidnapped an important scientist whose unique DNA is vital to their research in developing super-soldiers.
A woman whom Trivette knows comes to town saying she is looking for her father and asks for his help to find him. And when he brings her to him, she pulls a gun and kills him.
A (black) preacher who's a friend of Trent's dad is being targeted by a racist whom he helped send to prison.
Joe Lopez is a paroled convict wanting to stay clean and mend his relationship with his family. Unfortunately, he is being pressured to use his safecracking skills to help a gang pull a job.

Drug dealers are being more active and brazen trying to sell their drugs. They target a high school and a teacher is killed when he tries to run the dealers off school grounds. The students decide they must take back their school.
When their plane crashes in the wilderness, MacGyver and four teenage gang leaders struggle for survival.
When MacGyver agrees to bail out an old buddy, he winds up on a rescue mission in Central America to save another old buddy from drug smugglers.
MacGyver and Pete Thornton travel to Southeast Asia to rescue a group of orphans, a nun, and Mac's old flame, Debra Easton, whose lives are threatened by an oppressive regime.
MacGyver and a deaf school teacher, Carrie Linden, live out a nightmare when they stumble upon an ex-CIA agent's ingenious plan to steal a missile, piece by piece, and sell it on the black market.
A skater stages an attack on herself to win endorsements, then ices her accomplice---and frames her rival for the killing.

Soft music, candles, and a lifeless body dressed in lovely lingerie. These are the trademarks of 'The Casanova Killer,' a serial murderer who leaves only a stain of blood near the heart, and the sole of a foot marred by an 'X,' as forensic evidence.

Dr. Sloan and Steve investigate a private eye's murder in the not-very-pretty world of modeling.
A cardiologist and two business partners plot a deadly insurance scam.
A terrorist bombing ignites an undercover investigation involving an ambitious cop.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Big Shot Bud
programmes.d: Bud wants to buy Margaret a bottle of expensive perfume for her birthday but ends up getting himself into trouble yet again.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Hard Luck Leo
programmes.d: A visitor to the Anderson home begins taking advantage of the family.
When playing at school, a ball thrown breaks a window, and Jody is blamed. Jody denies doing it.
Since most of Cissy's friends are getting engaged and married, Cissy decides it is time for her and Gregg to be engaged, even if Gregg does not want it.

programmes.st: What's Funny about a Broken Leg?
programmes.d: Buffy breaks her leg while playing games with friends. When Uncle Bill tells her she will not be able to go to the circus, she is sad. Uncle Bill saves the day by bringing the circus act to the apartment building.
When the twins find out that Mr. French's birthday is approaching, they ask Cissy to help them set up a birthday party for Mr. French.
The twins make friends with a boy who does not have any parents and has run away from an orphanage. They hid him in the apartment, moving him from room to room, so the others do not find him.

When Bill is in Hong Kong for business, he works with Ng Ho. Bill is impressed with Ng Ho and invites him to visit New York. When Ng Ho stays with the Davis' he starts to help around the apartment, too efficiently and upsets Mr. French.
Uncle Bill and Mr. French take the twins on vacation to Boston while Cissy spends her vacation time in New York. Everyone seems to be off-sync as they miss each other.
A former sweetheart of French's, once a common worker, is now a wealthy single woman. She asks Mr. French to visit her in England, in the hopes to pursue their relationship.

Maude's all-out campaign to get a well-deserved salary raise for one of Walter's female employees backfires when the lady decides to take the raise...and Walter, too. Marcia Rodd guest stars as Walter's overly liberated employee.
The generation gap becomes the Grand Canyon when Maude agrees to chaperone Phillip's birthday party and comes face to face with today's youth.
Arthur instigates a doctors' strike, refusing to treat 'any' patients, but his convictions could prove to be very unhealthy when Walter and Vivian take ill.
Maude's up to her libido in sexual fantasies over a handsome government ecologist and Walter's up to his ears in jealousy.
The opening of a gay bar in the neighborhood sends a morally outraged Arthur to personally close its doors, while an infuriated Maude vows to dispel Arthur's bigotry.
More is at stake than the 'Businessman of the Year' award when Maude and Walter are the only two candidates.
'Twas the night before Christmas and all through the house...was chaos, Maude's holiday celebration seems to be turning out quite differently than she planned.
Maude's excitement over getting rid of an expensive white elephant turns to terror when she gets an offer she 'can't' refuse.
Maude is shocked and outraged when she receives a series of obscene phone calls, but her biggest shock is yet to come when she discovers who's on the other end.
Everyone gets into the act when Maude recruits her family and friends to sing and dance for a questionable charity telethon on the annual musical.

The Bunkers are having problems with their furnace which gets Archie entertaining the idea of moving. When an unscrupulous black real-estate salesman, Mr. Byrd, offers Archie a hefty sum of money for his home, Archie is all for it despite Mike's warnings.

Archie comes home from work in a particularly awful mood because he has to make an important decision at work. His decision to lay off a Puerto Rican leads to an interesting visit to the Bunker household.

It's Christmas Day and Archie is the only one not in the Christmas spirit. Mike and Gloria question him, but he refuses to reveal what's bugging him. The Jeffersons come over to wish the Bunkers a 'Merry Christmas'.

Archie comes home from work in a great mood and orders Edith to have dinner ready and waiting, because he has to watch the CBS Evening News to see himself on it. Archie was interviewed as a man-on-the-street voicing his opinions on Nixon's presidency.

Edith has been running herself ragged caring for Archie, Mike and Gloria, who have all come down with a terrible flu. This prompts her to call on her extremely liberal Cousin Maude to come and stay with the Bunkers and help out.

Archie, Mike and Gloria are stunned when Edith becomes a rollercoaster of moods, going from joy to anger to tears in a snap of a finger. Gloria sits her down and suggests that perhaps she's beginning menopause.

The Bunkers are celebrating Edith's birthday in the city when Archie discovers that Edith failed to mail out a payment to the insurance company. This leads him to run across the street to drop it off. On his way, he gets stuck in an elevator.

A man shows up at the Bunker's door claiming to be a government agent and begins asking questions about a neighbor of the Bunkers. Archie soon becomes paranoid when he receives a phone call from a neighbor saying that Archie too is being investigated.
Archie and Mike head down to the store to get some items and on the way out Archie witnesses a mugging. Archie doesn't want to get involved in the matter and refuses to tell the police what he saw.

Edith answers the door to find a woman on the stoop with a young boy. The woman mentions that she's dropping Mike's son off and leaves. Edith now finds herself in the awkward position of explaining to the rest of the family where the boy came from.

Vint takes Naomi to a romantic motel to celebrate their one-year anniversary, and Mama tags along to assist Aunt Effie, who fell. When Mama leaves Aunt Effie after a fight, she is forced to spend the night with Vint and Naomi.
Ellen talks Mama into holding Mayor Tutwiller's reelection campaign at her house, but when Mama ridicules the Mayor, he challenges her to run herself, much to Ellen's chagrin.
Mama is sworn in as Mayor and the whole family attends her inauguration, but she soon finds out that the job is not as easy as she originally thought.

Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for Best Classical Solo Vocal Album "Crazy Girl Crazy" (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) in 2018 and took home the Grammy for Artist of the Year in 2022.

Documentary exploring the development of music TV over the last 50 years and its power in popularizing the classical genre.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programmes.t: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programmes.d: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

In October 2020, German conductor Kevin John Edusei made his London Symphony Orchestra debut and led the orchestra in a performance of the suite from Mendelssohn's "A Midsummer Night's Dream" and more.
By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.

programmes.st: The Widow And The Wolf/Texas Drifter
programmes.d: After the murder of her aunt goes cold, a woman helps launch an advocate group that brings awareness to cases that have gone unsolved.

A high school janitor is suspected in the murder of a young girl, but with only circumstantial evidence to go on, police must let the case go cold. And a woman asks the police to reopen the 24-year-old case of her cousin's disappearance.

From England to Texas to Georgia, I.R. will go inside cold case units and watch as police use ballistics testing, old fashioned fingerprints and a new DNA data bank for criminals, to crack open the mysteries of unsolved crimes.

Investigators in Virginia, probing the murder case of a sailor, seek the help of a forensic anthropologist from the "body farm" in the Great Smoky Mountains. Dr. William Bass became an expert on the human body's rate of decay by watching bodies.
A district attorney uses a clever technique--a "John Doe indictment"--to give law enforcement officials the time they need to track down the Schoolgirl Rapist from Rochester, N. Y.
In Cree culture, a promise is sacred. When Cree woman Shirley Soosay goes missing in 1980, her niece Violet promises her grandmother that she will bring Shirley home.

programmes.st: The Boy And The Monster/Secret In The Cellar
programmes.d: In Portland, Maine a housewife disappears. One year later her body is unearthed in the cellar. I.R. unravels this cold case investigation from the inside out. With the help of science, police are able to uncover a blueprint of the crime.

When a schoolteacher is found murdered in her New Jersey apartment in the fall of 2009, suspicion is cast on her soon to be ex-husband. Long after the case goes cold, a detective embarks on a mission to help the man clear his name.
When a woman is found murdered in her mobile home, police make two shocking discoveries--her husband may not only have been the killer, but he may have also killed his first wife 31 years before.

A new fingerprint identification system helps detectives track down a killer after three years of searching. And a Georgia investigator gets to the bottom of a 16-year-old murder case when he discovers the victim's body -- in the bottom of a well.

programmes.st: Killer on Campus / The Bow Hunter
programmes.d: Thirty-two years after the killing of University of Michigan law student Jane Mixer, police use DNA found on her pantyhose to finally track down the killer.
A boy's toy Batmobile car provides an important clue for detectives struggling to make a case against a serial killer who stalks and kills waitresses.

A 23-year-old teacher vanished the evening before Easter after giving confession. Her body was later found floating in a drainage canal. At the time, a key witness hinted that a member of the Catholic clergy may have been responsible.

A 14-year-old boy is charged with the murder of his sister, but his public defender believes the real killer is still on the loose. And two deteriorated slides, made 16 years earlier, give police the evidence they need to reopen the cold case.

programmes.st: The Flaming Gorge Falls/Caught In The Mail
programmes.d: A man suspected of the cold case murder of his wife and son hatches a new plot to kill his mother and father; and detectives solve the 20-year-old murder of a teenager by tricking her killer into licking an envelope.

When a Nevada couple demands the return of a baby they had sold to another couple, the burned body of the baby turns up in Arizona. Then, a man discovers a barrel in his crawlspace that contains the body of a woman who has been dead for decades.

programmes.st: Mistaken for a Killer/The Boy and the Monster
programmes.d: Advances in DNA technology that take place over 20 years help police to finally identify the man who brutally stabbed two women to death.

Anthony Napoli and Nathan revisit some of the people the show has helped, including a ghost realtor, a teen vandal and a centerfold-turned-private eye.

The BAU hunts an UnSub in Phoenix who is kidnapping victims and depriving them of sleep. Also, Hotch and Garcia deal with the threat from the underground hitman group, the 'Dirty Dozen.'

The BAU implements an elaborate strategy to try and take down the 'Dirty Dozen' hitmen ring, with Reid playing a central role. Aubrey Plaza guest stars.
When bodies are discovered in public places throughout Boston, the BAU investigates whether the victims used a taxi or ride-share service before their deaths.
The BAU searches for a motive and an UnSub when victims are found in truck stop restrooms along highways throughout the South.
When an 18-year-old girl escapes from a suburban home where she was held captive for years with two other women, the BAU searches for the Unsub who kidnapped them.
The BAU searches Los Angeles after the team discovers security footage that shows an UnSub being invited into victims' homes. Carmine Giovinazzo guest stars.
When Morgan is abducted, the BAU scrambles to find him and save his life. Danny Glover guest stars.
The BAU heads to Wichita in search of an UnSub abducting children while their parents sleep. Also, Morgan tries to find who was responsible for his attack.
When an UnSub targets the BAU, the team goes into action to find out who is responsible.

When former BAU team member and current Interpol Agent Emily Prentiss tracks an international serial killer, she enlists the help of her friends at the BAU after she is convinced the UnSub's next victim is on American soil.

The BAU searches for an UnSub who is purposely disfiguring victims. Also, Rossi has an awkward reunion with his ex-wife, Hayden Montgomery, who kept his daughter, Joy, a secret from him for nearly 30 years. Sheryl Lee Ralph guest stars.

When guards at a Virginia prison intercept a package with evidence relating to the kidnapping of two boys several years ago, the BAU questions a notorious serial killer who may have information on the boys' whereabouts.
The BAU is shocked when Hotch is apprehended by a SWAT team and suspected of conspiracy, and as the team scrambles to prove his innocence, they suspect a larger plot is on the horizon.

Always trying to help out a friend, Jack Stewart offers his support when a con-man acquaintance tries to straighten out his life. Instead, Jack's entwined in a mysterious fatal car accident investigation involving a posh health spa.
